assessment: In this important study, the authors identify distinct roles for the calcium sensors synaptotagmin 7 and Doc2α in the regulation of asynchronous release and calcium-dependent synaptic vesicle docking in hippocampal neurons. The current work adds to the field by placing the role of the two proteins in a new context, where synaptotagmin 7 acts to promote synaptic vesicle docking and capture after a stimulus, while Doc2α has a role in specifically driving the asynchronous component of release as a calcium sensor. The methods, data, and analyses provide convincing support for the conclusions.
